title: Pricing Desk Note: Remaining-Term Scaling on Residential Electricity Supply Plan Changes
content:
Pricing desk note, Residential Electricity Supply plan changes.

**Rule.** The combined reduction on the plan-change rate (the per-kWh reductions on that rate added together into one figure) is multiplied by the long remaining-term factor of 1.5 when 6 or more whole months remain from the change request to the current contract end date, by the short remaining-term factor of 1.2 when 1 to 5 whole months remain, and is taken as it stands when less than one whole month remains or the agreement has no contract end date.

**Counting.** From the change request date to the contract end date recorded on the agreement before the change, in whole months; a month is whole once the same day of the month is reached. A month-to-month agreement has no contract end date.

| Change request (hypothetical) | Current contract end date | Whole months remaining | Combined reduction is |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-02-10 | 2026-08-10 | 6 | multiplied by 1.5 |
| 2026-02-10 | 2026-08-09 | 5 | multiplied by 1.2 |
| 2026-02-10 | 2026-03-10 | 1 | multiplied by 1.2 |
| 2026-02-10 | 2026-03-09 | 0 | taken as it stands |
| any | none, month-to-month | none | taken as it stands |

**Example (hypothetical).** A combined reduction of 0.45 cents per kWh with 8 whole months remaining becomes 0.675 cents per kWh.
